topic: Handling device session data migration and cleanup
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on data integrity issues related to facility changes. Specifically, [p1] questioned the source of 'is_fake' data and noted that session data from an airport moved to a new campaign/facility was still appearing in the old location.

Another concern involved migrating large amounts of historical session data (a full year) for one company into another via S3. The feasibility and best method for this migration were discussed, particularly regarding whether deleting the original data would be safe.

It was confirmed that if a facility is missing from a company record but sessions exist, they should not appear in the system.
decisions: The 'is_fake' metric was identified as a forecast.
action_items: Someone will attempt to clean up or filter the session data incrementally due to the large volume of records.
